samples.observation: A woman appears below thatch beside a dark opening, with one arm raised against its edge.
A woman reclines with her head on a pillow. The frame alone does not establish sleep, dreaming or her identity.
An inverted or reflection-like figure/detail with visible arms and ornaments. The sampled frame does not establish the surface, transition or narrative status.
Several figures are gathered outdoors around a large tree; a draped standing figure occupies the centre.
Four figures share an interior composition: two standing and two lower/seated. Their relationships and speech are not established.

editorial_decision.reason: The sampled doorway-like composition is not grounded as Satyabhama overhearing her parents. Adding a shape/posture inventory here would not explain the transformation from first-person narration and would invite an unsupported correspondence. The other isolated frames cannot establish timing, viewpoint, dialogue or a sequence.
editorial_decision.retain: Current literary encounter and independent film-credit sentence unchanged.
editorial_decision.future_dependency: A bounded coherent scene with actual continuous visual inspection and sufficient attributable speech/identity grounding. More silent stills alone do not resolve this dependency.

dependency.reason: Actual continuous audiovisual inspection or an attributable transcript is needed to identify a coherent scene and compare narration. Do not turn additional silent stills into a dialogue/perspective claim.
